dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: A habit you picked up at work?

dialogues.speaker: Sedile
dialogues.text: Yeah. I'm Sedile, an agent of the Marechaussee Phantom. My usual work involves site inspection and information collection — all to ensure the safety of Fontaine's citizens.

dialogues.speaker: Sedile
dialogues.text: So, well... Heh. When I see people I haven't seen before, I get a little nervous. Sorry about that.
